letter-spacing:.1em">ADM-PAY-03 · INVOICE DETAIL · ACCT, CM · DEFAULT
One invoice, and its life
INV-20418 UNPAID · 2 DAYS LATE
Ahmad Nabulsi · issued 17 Aug · due 17 Aug · Khalda
Take payment ⋯
DESCRIPTION
QTY
AMOUNT
Club membership · August
1–31 Aug · monthly rolling · tax exempt
1
55.00
Total
JOD 55.00
WHAT HAS HAPPENED TO THIS INVOICE
17 Aug 06:00 Issued and charged automatically
17 Aug 06:01 Declined · card expired · Visa ···4417
18 Aug 06:00 Retry 1 declined · same reason
19 Aug 06:12 Retry 2 declined · dunning stopped, 2 of 2 used
19 Aug 06:13 Reminder drafted, awaiting approval
JOFOTARA Not submitted — e-invoices are sent on payment, not issue
Jordan requires submission of the settled transaction. An unpaid invoice has nothing to report yet, so this state is correct rather than a failure.
STATES · ADM-PAY-03
Paid — status badge in success, JoFotara reference shown, Take payment replaced by Receipt. Refunded — original preserved, refund shown as a linked negative document, never an edit. Disputed — evidence deadline banner. Void — struck, reason and author recorded. JoFotara rejected — the field at fault named, with a fix-and-resubmit action.
IMMUTABILITY
Issued invoices are never edited. Corrections are credit notes with their own number and a link to the original. There is no edit affordance on this screen at any permission level — which is a design decision, not a missing feature, and the reason the timeline can be trusted as an audit trail.
PERMISSIONS
Accountant and Club Manager see everything here. Reception sees the invoice and Take payment but not the ⋯ menu (void, credit note, resend to JoFotara). Coach has no route to this screen at all.

Outside the 24-hour window only approved templates can open a conversation — free text is disabled and the reason is stated inline rather than the Send button silently failing.
ADM-SET-03 · TAX & E-INVOICING · JORDAN
Tax and invoicing
Nadi Group · Jordan · JOD
TAX NUMBER
1099238471
SALES TAX RATE
16% Retail only. Memberships are exempt in Jordan.
CONNECTED JoFotara e-invoicing
Submitting since 14 June. 1,847 invoices sent, 3 rejected this month — all three for a missing buyer tax number, all corrected and resubmitted.
Test connection Submission log
Buyer tax number is required for business sales. When a member is registered as a company, the field becomes mandatory at the point of sale rather than failing later at submission — which is what caused this month's three rejections, and is now prevented upstream.
Global shape, local content. This screen is TaxIntegration — JoFotara is the Jordan adapter. A UK tenant sees HMRC MTD in the same frame with different fields. Nothing here is hard-coded to Jordan except the adapter's own configuration.

SCALE · 500 TO 100,000
Nothing on this screen enumerates the full set. Filters query server-side, the count states matches against total, selection is bounded to the loaded page with an explicit “select all 18 matching” when a filter is active. There is no state where 4,812 rows render. At 100,000 the only change is that the unfiltered default becomes “recently active” rather than everyone.

Empty search names the query and offers to clear filters, never “no data”. Loading is 12 skeleton rows at 34px. letter-spacing:.1em">ADM-CC-06 · ATTENTION ITEM DETAIL · SIDE SHEET OVER THE COMMAND CENTER
Where an exception gets resolved
MONEY · CRITICAL
EXC-8841 · raised 06:12 · 2h ago
✕
6 payments failed overnight JOD 312.00
Four expired cards, two insufficient funds, across Khalda and Abdoun. Veyro retried each twice on the 18th and 19th. No access is blocked — Nadi Group's policy allows 14 days' grace, so all six can train today.
OWNER
Unassigned
AGE
2h 14m
AFFECTED
6 members
SOURCE
Billing run · automatic
THE SIX RECORDS · EACH LINKS TO ITS MEMBER
{{ a.name }}
{{ a.reason }}
{{ a.amount }}
Open ↗
WHAT VEYRO HAS ALREADY DONE
19 Aug 06:12 Billing run · 6 of 214 charges declined
19 Aug 06:13 6 reminder messages drafted, held for approval
19 Aug 06:13 Exception raised to the Command Center
Send 6 payment links
Open recovery workspace
Assign to…
Snooze
Resolving from here collapses the row in the Command Center with a 30-second undo. Snoozing requires a reason and a return date — an exception cannot be dismissed, only deferred with an account of why.
STATES · ADM-CC-06
Unassigned as drawn. Assigned to me shows the owner and adds Release. Assigned to someone else keeps every action visible but read-only, with "Nadia is handling this" and a Take over that records the handover. Resolved shows the outcome, resolver and elapsed time, and offers Reopen. Snoozed shows the reason and return date.
PERMISSIONS
A Club Manager sees only the two members at their club and a JOD total scoped to them. Reception can open the sheet but has no batch action — only Take payment per member. An exception a role cannot act on never enters their queue in the first place.
KEYBOARD
Opens with focus on the heading, not the primary action — a destructive default under a returning Enter key is how batch messages get sent by accident. Esc closes and returns focus to the originating row.

letter-spacing:.1em">ADM-MSH-02 · 03 · 04 · 06 · 09 · THE REST OF THE LIFECYCLE
Renew, freeze, resume, downgrade, and the plan catalogue
ADM-MSH-02 · RENEW
Renew Lina Haddad · Club+
The price has changed since she last renewed
She paid JOD 72.00 . Club+ is now JOD 78.00 . Tell her before you take payment.
12 months at 78.00 936.00
Annual discount 15% −140.40
Today 795.60
Take 795.60 Monthly instead
The price-change disclosure is not dismissible and is not a tooltip. A member discovering a rise on their statement is a complaint; hearing it at the desk is a conversation.
ADM-MSH-03 · FREEZE
Freeze Ahmad's membership
FROM
1 Sep
UNTIL
1 Oct
REASON
Travel ▾
Billing pauses from 1 Sep · access off for the month · renewal moves to 21 Oct · his Club rate is held · 2 of 3 freeze months used this year
Freeze Cancel
At 3 of 3 the action blocks and names the manager who can override. Tier 2 — undoable for 30 seconds, because a freeze applied to the wrong member is common and cheap to reverse.
ADM-MSH-04 · RESUME EARLY
Yara is back early
Frozen until 1 October. Resuming today restarts billing and access immediately.
Rest of August · 12 days 30.19
Renewal returns to 1 Sep
One freeze month is returned to her allowance — she used 1 of the 2 she booked.
Resume · take 30.19
Access is restored on confirm, not overnight. A member standing at the desk expects the turnstile to work before they walk away from it.
ADM-MSH-06 · DOWNGRADE · TIER 3
Dana · Club+ to Club
She loses
Access to Abdoun and Sweifieh · 2 monthly PT sessions · her 4 unused PT credits expire on 1 Sep
Takes effect 1 September , not today — she has paid for August at the higher rate and keeps it. New monthly: JOD 55.00 .
Use the credits first
Downgrade from 1 Sep
The loss is stated before the saving, and the credit expiry is the line that matters — a member who discovers it afterwards has been quietly charged for something they never got.

screens.text:
letter-spacing:.1em">ADM-PAY-06 · ADM-PAY-09 · ADM-PAY-10
Dunning rules, the cash drawer, and a disputed charge
ADM-PAY-06 · DUNNING · OWNER & ACCOUNTANT
When a payment fails
Retry the card twice , one day apart, at 06:00 .
Draft a message after the final failure and hold it for approval .
Allow access for 14 days past the due date.
Raise a Command Center exception when 3 or more fail in one run.
NEVER, WHATEVER THE RULES SAY
Never block access without a person deciding · never message outside 09:00–20:00 · never send more than one reminder a week · never charge a card that has been removed.
Sentence form, same as the automation builder. The NEVER block is not configurable per-tenant — it is the floor beneath every dunning policy.
ADM-PAY-09 · CASH RECONCILIATION
Closing Layla's shift
Khalda · 16:00–22:04
Opening float 50.00
Cash taken · 14 sales 96.00
Cash refunded −8.00
Should be in the drawer 138.00
COUNTED
135.50
Short by 2.50
Above the JOD 2.00 threshold, so a note is required and Ziad must co-sign.
What happened…
Close & request co-sign
The expected figure is shown before the count is entered. Hiding it would be a fraud control; showing it is an accuracy control, and accuracy is the more common problem.
ADM-PAY-10 · DISPUTE · ACCOUNTANT ONLY
DISPUTED INV-19102
Faris Alami's bank has challenged JOD 78.00 from 2 June, claiming the service was not received. The amount is held by the acquirer.
Evidence due 26 August · 7 days
Missing the deadline forfeits the amount automatically.
EVIDENCE VEYRO CAN ASSEMBLE
☑ 11 check-ins in the billed month
☑ Signed membership contract
☑ Invoice and JoFotara reference
☐ Written statement · you add this
Submit evidence Accept the loss

letter-spacing:.1em">ADM-AI-01 · AI INSIGHT DETAIL · THE DESTINATION OF EVERY EVIDENCE LINK
Why Veyro said PT revenue fell JOD 1,840
✦
VEYRO INTERPRETATION · FULL DERIVATION
generated 08:38 · 1.2s
THE CLAIM
Khalda's PT revenue is JOD 1,840 below the same point in July, and roughly JOD 1,240 of that is recoverable.
WHAT WAS READ
SOURCE
RECORDS
WHAT IT CONTRIBUTED
{{ s.name }}
{{ s.n }}
{{ s.what }}
THE ARITHMETIC
July 1–19 · PT billed at Khalda 6,420.00
August 1–19 · PT billed at Khalda 4,580.00
Difference −1,840.00
Sessions delivered, not verified 31
Average billed rate at Khalda 40.00
Recoverable if all 31 are genuine 1,240.00
WHAT VEYRO IS AND IS NOT CONFIDENT ABOUT
CERTAIN The JOD 1,840 gap and the 31 unverified sessions. Both are counted from records, not estimated.
LIKELY That most of the 31 are genuine. Omar's historical verification rate is 94%, so the 1,240 figure is an upper bound , not an expectation.
UNCERTAIN That the roster change caused the decline. Omar's remaining nine clients also booked 18% less often, which the roster change does not explain. Veyro cannot separate the two.
WHAT THIS IS NOT
Not a forecast, not a confirmed recovery, and not a judgement about Omar's performance. It is a reading of billing records with the reasoning shown. Nothing here has been acted on — the request to verify has not been sent.
Open the 31 sessions
Preview the request to Khalda
This is wrong
"This is wrong" records the disagreement against the insight with a reason, and the same reading is not raised again for 30 days. An interpretation a manager cannot contradict is not an interpretation.
WHY THREE CONFIDENCE BANDS AND NOT A PERCENTAGE
A number like "82% confident" reads as measured precision about something that is a judgement. Three named bands — counted, likely, cannot separate — say the same thing without borrowing authority the reasoning does not have.
STATES · ADM-AI-01
Stale inputs withholds the insight entirely rather than reasoning from old figures. Insufficient data says which comparison could not be made. Disputed shows the manager's objection above the claim. Acted on shows what was done, by whom, and what changed afterwards.
PERMISSIONS
Owner and Regional see cross-club derivations. A Club Manager sees their own club's arithmetic. Reception never reaches this screen — an insight nobody can act on is noise. The indigo is color.semantic.ai and never inherits a tenant brand.
